facts.fact: People of Internet says Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 has a full compliance deadline of 1 November 2026.

facts.fact: People of Internet says the Executive Regulations of Law No. 151 of 2020 entered force in November 2025.

facts.fact: People of Internet says the Personal Data Protection Center has been operational since late 2025.
People of Internet says the Personal Data Protection Center's initial guidance has focused on consent and breach-notification requirements.
